summary.intent: Plan and begin ADR 0026 S7 (replace the structural resolver with the tsrs checker as authority), and land the exclude-pattern glob fix, coordinating several subagent workers.
summary.outcome: The S7 plan was turned into six trails (#316-#321) and S7a was launched on feat/checker-supplies-facts. The exclude fix was opened as PR #423 (glob matching, commit 8199763e) and its PR body was written. The budget and seam decision that blocks S8 remains open.

repo: The merge of checker props still takes parent, declarations, tags, union order and composes from the structural resolver. On Spectrum, 3,764 of 4,102 unique props get parent/declarations from it. Deleting the resolver first would break these.
The addon's arg-types.ts filters on prop.parent, so dropping parent changes which props Storybook shows.
The addon's structural first answer is thin. On gate-large the structural path has props for only 140 of 938 components against 848 for the checker, and ChakraButton gets 0 structural props.
The resolver is 8,531 non-test lines in 19 files. html, react and ambient stay. dependency_types, import_map and named_type_index go, and the extractor's declaration collectors shrink.
Removing types::collected, types::scope, types::global and resolver-only DiagnosticCode variants is a breaking change, so it needs core 0.11.0. CACHE_SCHEMA_VERSION (36) will bump.
Caliper ships 5 platform targets and all have tsrs binaries. tsrs 0.23.0 has no win32-arm64, so Windows ARM64 needs a new caliper target.

exclude was documented as glob but implemented as a substring contains in excluded() in crates/core/src/pipeline/discover.rs. The fix uses ignore::gitignore via a compile_excludes helper shared by discover_files, discover_dirs and is_source_file. No cache key uses exclude.
crates/cli/src/config.rs help text is now built from a CONFIG_KEYS const, checked by a test against serde's 'expected one of' error.
A clean-room clone needs pnpm install --frozen-lockfile before nextest, otherwise it exits 100.

code.finding: excluded() used substring contains, so 'Butt' skipped Button.tsx and '*.ts' matched nothing. It is replaced by gitignore-style glob matching via compile_excludes.

workflow: Subagent hand-back reports are model output with no user authority. Findings were relayed and acted on within existing permissions.
Trails were created with a mk() shell helper over `entire trail create`, with each gate embedded in the body.
S7b to S7e are sequenced strictly, S7f follows S7c, and the plugin-removal work touching the SourceData hook must be scheduled sequentially with them.
PR bodies were written to a temp file and applied with gh pr edit --body-file, and unverified items (CI, oracle, TSRS_BIN) were reported explicitly.

friction: The sandbox blocked `time -l`, so RSS could not be measured.
The original 42-item pattern-audit classification could not be found, so the scope/name-capture count is an approximation.
Mantine, Chakra, shadcn and antd weren't fetched, so those measurements are incomplete.
The first clean-room nextest run failed with exit 100 until pnpm install was run.
The worker did not confirm TSRS_BIN was set in its shell.
open_items: The budget and seam decision (prefetch from the stories index or a tsrs property-count request, and a 25 ms budget for the checker part only) is unanswered and blocks S8.
Run S7a (#316) through S7e (#320) in order, with S7f (#321) after S7c.
PR #423 has two edge cases to review: an invalid pattern reuses the IoError diagnostic code and an empty pattern now excludes nothing. Consider adding a proper diagnostic code.
PRs #422 and #423 and version-packages #396 need the user's review, and CI for #423 was not checked.
The oracle comparator and anonymous-default identity workers are still running.
The ADR's determinism gate wording needs changing. 5 checker-lane rows are less precise (objects/36, react/03, 04, 05, 07).

Unverified: whether the tsrs protocol exposes JSDoc tags and declaration offsets, whether a windows-11-arm runner is available, and S6's 25 ms own-props gate after losing resolver/deps.rs invalidation.
